svg.desc: Equally cropped renders from a controlled fixture show the labelled stages.

g.text: Manual geometry and subsequent layout recalculation
After: B moved, C widened, D taller, E rotated 90°
After adding child F triggers recalculation
The extra insertion is a separate controlled check of reflow.
Adding a node can change previously adjusted positions and sizes.
